invented.quote: That shift has no supervisor on site.
invented.why: The brief says Tomás runs the 3 a.m. milking shift on his own, not that there is no supervisor anywhere on the farm site during that time.

invented.quote: He is responsible for the herd, the equipment, and anything that goes wrong until the rest of the crew arrives.
invented.why: The brief only states that he runs the 3 a.m. milking shift on his own, without specifying that he is responsible for the entire herd, equipment, or waiting until the rest of the crew arrives.

invented.quote: He has also grown well beyond the work he was hired to do.
invented.why: The brief does not mention what specific work Tomás was originally hired to do.

invented.quote: On his own initiative, Tomás learned our herd management software
invented.why: The brief states that he learned the herd management software, not that he did so on his own initiative rather than being trained or asked to learn it.

invented.quote: Tomás communicates clearly and confidently in spoken English.
invented.why: The brief only says that his written English is weaker than his spoken English, not that his spoken English is clear and confident.
